- P1 (3): .6 reference-only filter/sort rustdoc, .17 create_object id invariant tightened + MockBackend fixed + dual regression tests.

- .2 objects_mut side-effect — same shape in 6 sibling MemoryBackends.

- .6 reference-only rustdoc — 6 sibling MemoryBackends.
- .28 &mut self add_notification — same shape in jmap-tasks-server and jmap-calendars-server.

Follow-up bead filed:

Two commits:
- 5d516e1 fix(sharing-server): P0/P1 correctness pass — 5 files, +434/-25.
